problem:
Let $R=[-2,2]\times [-2,2]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=2x+y+10.$
Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}={-2,0,2},\,{P}_{2}={-2,0,2},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the upper Riemann sum $U(f,P).$
worked_solution:
First, let's draw the region $R$ and the partition $P.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14072318/assets/6a44295e07e8d14dfae78403d4629bde77c522136d5ffec16ace6416db72303e.png)

The upper sum $U(f,P)$ is given by

$$
U(f,P)={M}_{11}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{11})+{M}_{21}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{21})+{M}_{12}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{12})+{M}_{22}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{22}),
$$

where ${M}_{ij}$ is the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ We pick the *maximum* value of $f$ because we're finding the *upper* sum.

Taking into account the fact that $\text{Area}({R}_{ij})=4$ for all $4$ subregions, the formula for $U(f,P)$ reduces to

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & =4\cdot {M}_{11}+4\cdot {M}_{21}+4\cdot {M}_{12}+4\cdot {M}_{22} \\  & =4({M}_{11}+{M}_{21}+{M}_{12}+{M}_{22}).\end{aligned}
$$

Now, notice that

- $f(x,y)=2x+y+10$ increases as $x$ increases, and

- $f(x,y)=2x+y+10$ increases as $y$ increases.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14072318/assets/bdb4b6095c1b449d8e048f85a0d4d289758597af520ed61f545dbe280560ca15.png)

As a result, the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the *largest* possible $x$ and the *largest* possible $y.$ This is the value at the *top right corner* of each subregion.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14072318/assets/ca1c7e423afd88b0f1b18570bad73897092167ad338dcdbe275aaf451a08b3cb.png)

Hence:

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{11} & =f(0,0)=10 \\ {M}_{21} & =f(2,0)=14 \\ {M}_{12} & =f(0,2)=12 \\ {M}_{22} & =f(2,2)=16\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & =4(10+14+12+16) \\  & =208.\end{aligned}
$$
